description: This script provides functions for managing firmware upgrade procedures on specific hardware, including mangling boot configuration data and preparing the device for upgrade.

methods.name: asrock_bootconfig_mangle
methods.description: Modifies the boot configuration partition to set or clear flags for firmware upgrades or checks.

methods.name: asrock_upgrade_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the device for system upgrade by updating boot flags and removing certain UBI volumes.
